reviewedExamples.independentEditorialNote: City proper name/capitalization. Leaving luggage at hotel before walking around city is natural; Chinese preserves action and order. explore Sydney on foot is a specific collocation, no present travel assertion.
British noun permit in driving licence, found under receipts. Chinese location and possessive correspond; no licensing verb or legal instruction. Printed n.执照/source100 verified.
Intelligent pupil solving a puzzle without requesting a hint illustrates printed聪明的. EN/Chinese agree, clever pupil adjective-noun collocation appropriate, not clever trick meaning.
stupid of me to do something correctly judges the speaker's unwise act, not a third-person insult or numbness. Ticket-left-at-home details match Chinese.
Low-price lunches in a café, no automatic poor quality. Chinese retains college-nearby location and price meaning. cheap lunches natural plural.
Ticket is too expensive, therefore bus chosen. Chinese preserves reasoning; an expensive ticket naturally exemplifies adjective without claiming luxurious.

stale and dry after bag open overnight is natural food-not-fresh scene. Chinese matches staleness and dryness without claiming rotting/rancidity. Ledger retains raw变馊的 and explicitly labels editorial normalization. Raw变馊/腐馊/酸败 labels excluded by actual helper.
High-volume upstairs music adjective; Chinese reflects source and interruption. loud music does not certify adverb or showy clothing.
Physical ceiling height with spacious-room effect. 高高的天花板 accurately renders high ceiling; no stature/price/status/adverb expansion.
Cushion soft enough to act as pillow: material tactile meaning. Chinese and a soft cushion agree; no kindness, weakness or voice target.
lemonade tasted sour due to omitted sugar; tasting-state adjective, not become-sour verb or mood. Chinese causal relationship and taste sour match.
carried a spare umbrella in her bag in case it rained is natural past precaution. Chinese preserves spare umbrella and purpose; canonical carry, not past headcarried or support/contain branches.

Imperative correct the address before posting parcel, clearly printed correcting verb. Chinese更正 and collocation更正地址 are accurate synonyms of原印改正/纠正; recorded proposal change covers Chinese/collocation revision. Wrong adjective/POS labels reject.

the least sugar among3 recipes naturally expresses minimum amount of mass noun. Chinese minimum quantity matches. Raw最小的/最少的 and traditional adj. label retained separately from modern determiner analysis; no smallest physical object or adverb least.
be worse than expected about weather is comparative adjective; Chinese更糟 preserves bad comparative and picnic postponement. Headworse retained, not bad or malformed forms.
was asleep is predicate state adjective, lowering radio natural response. Chinese睡着 correct, not sleeping verb or numbness/death. be asleep collocation appropriate; source用作表语 preserved.
Full compound noun in write the date at top of new page. Chinese new-page top and date match; write in an exercise book natural. Source actually PDF247/printed243, no fitness manual.
Physical village road narrows beyond an old bridge; EN/Chinese spatial relations agree. the road to the village literal, not road to success metaphor.
Single young cat hid under sofa when cleaner started; Chinese preserves both trigger and place without universal animal assertion. Animal noun/POS and canonical head retained.

Passengers get off before speaker boards bus, natural past sequence. Chinese下车/上公交 agree; canonical get on despite got on surface. Source has no printed POS; inferred verb phrase explicitly recorded, not falsely attributed to source.
Hyphenated adjective modifies neighbour in concrete helping scene. Chinese preserves age group and carrying table upstairs; no invented exact age or gender and no middle age noun.
looked worried when train still had not arrived is emotion-state adjective. Chinese迟迟没到/显得担心 matches; raw担心/担忧 POSadj. retained with Chinese grammatical的 normalization. No unhappy or worry verb.

Library visits regularly, usually Friday afternoons, naturally represents repeated customary frequency, not guaranteed schedule. Chinese经常/通常 agree. Actual printclear经常地 is the only certified target; unreadable tail is explicitly unresolved, not guessed.
